content.text: The capital of France is Paris. Paris is not only the capital but also the largest city in France, known for its significant influence in various fields such as art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture. It is located in the northern part of the country along the Seine River. Paris is home to many famous landmarks and institutions, including the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, Notre-Dame Cathedral, and the Palace of Versailles. The city is divided into 20 administrative arrondissements (districts), each with its own unique character and attractions. As a global city, Paris plays a crucial role in international diplomacy, hosting numerous embassies and being the seat of various international organizations.
